items.h: Nick Folk Kicks His Way into Streaming Pool in Week 8
items.s: Atlanta Falcons kicker Nick Folk was a perfect 3-for-3 on field goal attempts last week, though he missed his first extra point of the season, going 2-for-3 in Week 7. Over the last five weeks, the veteran is 9-for-9 on field goal tries, although none have been 50-plus yarders, with the average coming in at a meager 34 yards during that span. With the Atlanta offense looking more competent and scoring more points with Michael Penix Jr. under center, there should continue to be opportunities for Folk to put up points. The 41-year-old is a worthy streamer again in Week 8 against the Buccaneers, a defense that has the ability to stall drives before reaching the end zone, but there might be…

items.h: Makes three field goals in win
items.s: Folk made all three of his field-goal tries while going 2-for-3 on PATs during Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers. Folk was able to match his season high in field-goal makes, converting attempts from 39 and 33 yards in the first half before adding a 31-yarder to put the team up 29-20 with 1:56 left in regulation. The 41-year-old continues to be an effective short-range option for Atlanta, going 11-for-12 on field-goal attempts from less than 50 yards over seven contests this season.

items.h: Nick Folk puts 11 points on the board in Week 7 win
items.s: Nick Folk made all three of his field-goal attempts and 2-of-3 PATs in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers. Folk missed a PAT in this one, but that was the veteran kicker's only blemish. Folk is now 12 of 15 on FG attempts this season, with a long of 51 yards.

items.h: Nick Folk an Intriguing Option at Kicker in Week 7
items.s: Atlanta Falcons kicker Nick Folk has been solid as of late, but was not a factor in last week's loss to the Bears. The veteran did not attempt a field goal, but did convert his lone extra point attempt, making him a perfect 13-for-13 on the season. The former Pro-Bowler was 6-for-6 in the three games prior to last week with a long of 48 yards, and is 9-for-12 on the season, with two of his three misses coming from beyond 50 yards. This week's matchup against the 49ers has a surprisingly large expected total (49.5), with the Falcons owning a 23.5-point implied team total, so there could be a decent amount of scoring in this one. With the game being in Atlanta, the kickers will not have to…

items.h: Kicks one PAT in loss
items.s: Folk made his sole PAT in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday. Folk attempted no field goals and kicked just one PAT in the loss. The kicker is still 9-for-12 on field-goal attempts and remains a perfect 13-for-13 on PATs through six regular-season contests in 2026.

items.h: Nick Folk makes lone kick in Week 6
items.s: Nick Folk converted his lone extra point attempt in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6. Folk was held back by an Atlanta offense forced to play catchup Sunday, recording less than three points for the first time in six contests in the loss. The kicker will face another stiff test in a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.h: Nick Folk a Viable Streamer in Potential High-Scoring Contest
items.s: Atlanta Falcons kicker Nick Folk was 3-for-3 on field goal attempts last week, making him 6-for-6 over the last three weeks (9-for-12 overall) while going 12-for-12 on extra points so far this season. The veteran's recent success can be partly attributed to the fact that he hasn't had a field goal try longer than 50 yards since Week 2, with two of his three misses this season coming from 50-plus. The 41-year-old may not be the best streaming option in leagues that reward longer field goals, but there have been many more opportunities for points since Michael Penix Jr. took over at the helm for Atlanta, and this week's matchup against the Bears has one of the highest over/unders on the…

items.h: Makes all five kicks in OT loss
items.s: Folk converted all five of his kicks (three field goals, two extra points) during Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens. All three of Folk's field goals came in the second half, including a 48-yarder late in the fourth quarter to give the Falcons a 23-15 lead. His three made field goals were his most of the season, and after missing three kicks in each of his first two games, Folk has made all six of his field-goal tries over his last three outings. The Falcons will stay home for Week 6 against the Bears on Oct. 18.

items.h: Nick Folk makes all five of his kicks Sunday night
items.s: Nick Folk made all three of his field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 30-23 loss to the Ravens. Folk has been automatic over the last three weeks, making 6-of-6 field goals and 11-of-11 PATs for the Falcons. The veteran is a solid fantasy option, but with QB Michael Penix's (ribs) health status in question again, the Falcons' offense could take a step back.

items.h: Nick Folk Moves into Streaming Range for Week 5
items.s: Atlanta Falcons kicker Nick Folk, after starting the year 3-for-6 on field goal tries, is now 3-for-3 over the last two games and is a perfect 10-for-10 on extra points so far this season. Week 5 brings a favorable matchup against the Ravens, who will be without QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) and LB Trey Hendrickson (finger), making the Falcons three-point home favorites in Atlanta on Sunday night. Being in the dome in Atlanta means that the veteran kicker will not have to deal with the elements, and with the team owning an implied point total of 23.5, there should be a decent amount of scoring. It all sets the 41-year-old up as a potential streaming option in Week 5, ranking as the No. 20…

items.h: Nick Folk scores nine points Monday
items.s: Nick Folk went 6-for-6 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Monday's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints. The veteran played well on Monday, knocking down all seven of his attempted kick en route to a blowout win over the Saints. Atlanta's offense has looked great over the past couple of weeks, so Folk could be considered a decent starting option if he proves he can still be consistent at this point in his career.

items.h: Folk made his lone field-goal attempt all six PATs in Monday night's 45-24 win over the Saints.
items.s: The Falcons dominated this game from start to finish and ran the ball down New Orleans' throat, especially in the red zone, which kept Folk kicking extra points. His field goal was good from 29 yards, and the 41-year-old has made just six of nine field-goal tries and all 10 PATs through four games. All three of his misses this season are from 40-plus yards.

items.h: Folk hit both field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in Thursday's 35-14 win over the Packers.
items.s: The kicker did his job during the blowout win, with his longest field goal connecting from 44 yards out. Folk missed three field goals across Atlanta's first two games, both losses, but he bounced back Thursday night. If the Falcons can keep scoring, he is a viable fantasy option.

items.h: Folk made one of his two field-goal attempts in Sunday's 34-3 loss to the Panthers.
items.s: Folk missed a 53-yard field goal in the fourth quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker's 41-yard attempt near the end of the first half was the Falcons' only points on the afternoon. Folk is now 3-for-6 on field-goal attempts and has made his sole PAT over the first two weeks of the season.

items.h: Folk went 2-for-4 on field-goal attempts and hit his only extra-point try in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Steelers.
items.s: The kicker did connect from 43 and 51 yards, respectively, but he also missed from 45 and 54. Folk missed only one field-goal try in each of the last three regular seasons.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts and all four PAT tries in Saturday's 34-6 preseason win over the Colts.
items.s: Folk posting an accurate performance is nothing new, as he has missed exactly one field-goal attempt in each of the past three regular seasons. The 41-year-old kicker showed he still has some power left in his leg as well Saturday, as he converted 51-yard and 50-yard field-goal attempts Saturday.

items.h: Folk agreed to terms Monday on a two-year contract with the Falcons, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Folk, who is heading into his age-42 season, converted 28 of 29 field-goal tries and all 16 of his PATs across 16 regular-season appearances with the Jets in 2025, and he remains one of the league's more accurate kickers, having led the position in field-goal accuracy each of the last three years. He will start for Atlanta in 2026, a landing spot that figures to provide increased scoring opportunities compared to what he saw most recently in New York.

items.h: Folk announced he intends to play in 2026, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Folk will return for another NFL season after converting 28 of 29 field-goal attempts and all 22 of his extra-point tries across 16 games with the Jets last year. The 41-year-old is set to become a free agent once the new league year begins and will be one of the top options available at kicker.

items.h: Folk made 28 of 29 field-goal attempts and all 22 of his extra-point tries over 16 games during the 2025-26 campaign.
items.s: The Jets finished with the NFL's fourth-lowest-scoring offense, so opportunities weren't exactly ripe for Folk. However, the veteran kicker was outstanding when called upon, missing just one of his 51 total kicks. Folk made a career-best seven FGs from 50-plus yards out, with his only miss of the season being a 55-yard try in Week 13. He's slated to be a free agent, but it wouldn't be surprising if the Jets try to bring back Folk considering his very strong recent success -- he's led NFL kickers in FG accuracy each of the past three campaigns, going a tremendous 78-for-81 during that span.

items.h: Folk made his lone field-goal attempt and his only PAT in Sunday's 42-10 loss to the Patriots.
items.s: Folk's field goal was good from 39 yards. That was just about the extent of his action, as the Jets once again failed to threaten the end zone for much of the afternoon. Through 16 games this season, Folk is 28-for-29 on field goals and a perfect 22-for-22 on extra points.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts during Sunday's 29-6 loss to the Saints.
items.s: Folk converted on 29- and 36-yard field-goal tries in the first half but wasn't given any other opportunities to score during Sunday's loss. The 41-year-old has been one of the NFL's best kickers this season, making 27 of 28 field-goal attempts and all 21 of his point-after tries through 15 games. His next opportunity to kick will come in the Week 17 matchup against the Patriots.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts and both of his point-after tries during the Jets' 48-20 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.s: Folk made easy work of a 41-yarder late in the second quarter before sneaking in a 51-yard field goal early in the third frame. It's the 10th time this season that the veteran kicker has made at least two field goals in a game. Folk is now 25-for-26 on field-goal attempts and 21-for-21 on extra-point tries through 14 regular-season games.

items.h: Folk made his only field-goal try and PAT in Sunday's 34-10 loss to the Dolphins.
items.s: Folk made a 31-yard field goal in the fourth quarter, securing at least one field-goal make for the 12th time this season. Although the Jets' offense isn't particularly strong, the kicker still ranks amongst the best at his position this season, going 23-for-24 on field-goal attempts, including 6-for-7 from 50-plus yards, over 13 games so far.

items.h: Folk made two of three field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in the Jets' 27-24 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
items.s: Folk entered Week 13 having made all 35 of his kicks this season, and his first miss came in the third quarter Sunday, as he was short on a 55-yard attempt in the third quarter. Folk was kicking in sloppy, rainy conditions but was able to redeem himself with a 56-yard, game-winner as time expired in the fourth quarter, as he barely snuck it inside the left upright just above the crossbar. On the season, Folk has converted 22 of 23 field-goal attempts and all 18 of his extra points.

items.h: Folk made his only field-goal try and extra-point attempt in Sunday's 23-10 loss to the Ravens.
items.s: Folk was able to convert a 42-yard field-goal attempt in the fourth quarter, making the most of his only opportunity on the day. The kicker has now gone back-to-back contests without attempting multiple field goals, something he hadn't done to this point in the season. Folk is now up to a perfect 20-for-20 on field-goal tries over 11 contests this year.

items.h: Folk did not attempt a field goal and made both of his PATs in Thursday night's 27-14 loss to the Patriots.
items.s: Folk went without a field-goal try for the first time this season and Thursday's performance marked the first contest in which he didn't make multiple field goals since Week 2. The kicker has gone a perfect 19-for-19 on field-goal tries, including 5-for-5 from 50-plus yards, while making all 14 of his PATs over 10 games this year.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts and all three of his point-after tries during the Jets' 27-20 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: The Jets' defense and special teams did most of the scoring in the first half, and Folk helped give his team a three-point lead with a 26-yard chip shot at the end of the second quarter. He followed that up with a 37-yard field goal in the fourth quarter, which gave the Jets a 10-point cushion. Folk has made at least two field goals in eight of the first nine games of the regular season and has converted on all 19 of his field-goal attempts and each of his 21 extra-point tries in 2025.

items.h: Folk connected on all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Jets' 39-38 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
items.s: Folk put the Jets on the board early in the second quarter with a 46-yard field goal before connecting on two more chips shots from 25 and 24 yards. The 15-year veteran has yet to miss a kick through eight regular-season games, having gone 17-for-17 on field-goal tries and 9-for-9 on extra-point attempts in 2025.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 13-6 loss to the Panthers.
items.s: The kicker connected from 34 yards in the second quarter and from 47 in the fourth. Folk is 14-of-14 on field goals and 7-of-7 on extra points in 2025, but the Jets' struggling offense limits his opportunities.

items.h: Folk made all three of his field-goal tries during the Jets' 13-11 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.
items.s: The Jets offense struggled to move the ball down the field Sunday, but Folk helped New York keep pace with field goals from 52, 41 and 38 yards. His three made field goals were his most in a game in 2025, and the veteran kicker has converted on all 12 of his field-goal attempts and all seven of his extra-point tries through the first six games of the regular season.

items.h: Folk connected on both of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 37-22 loss to the Cowboys.
items.s: The kicker made a 25-yarder in the first quarter and a 48-yarder in the third, though he did not get a chance to attempt an extra point. Folk is now 9-for-9 on field goals and 7-for-7 on extra points in 2025. At the same time, his kicking opportunities depend on a Jets offense that has been inconsistent so far this season.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal tries and his lone extra-point attempt Monday in a loss to Miami.
items.s: Folk ended the first half in impressive fashion, making a 58-yard field goal as time expired for the longest successful attempt of his career. The grizzled veteran added a mere 50-yard make early in the fourth quarter and also made his only extra-point try. Folk has gone a perfect 7-for-7 on field-goal attempts (including 4-for-4 from 50-plus yards) and has made all seven of his extra-point tries through four weeks.

items.h: Folk hit both of his field-goal tries and all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 29-27 loss to the Bucs.
items.s: Folk's field goals came from 38 and 42 yards, respectively. He's now five of five on field-goal attempts and six of six on extra-point tries in 2025. The veteran made 50 of 52 field-goal attempts over the last two seasons with the Titans, so he remains reliable.

items.h: Folk made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on his only PAT try in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Bills.
items.s: Folk made a 51-yard field-goal attempt in the second quarter, showing that the 40-year-old kicker still has some power left in his leg. The made PAT came on the heels of a fourth-quarter touchdown pass by Tyrod Taylor, who could start at quarterback in Week 3 against the Buccaneers after Justin Fields suffered a concussion in the loss to Buffalo.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts and both PAT tries in Sunday's 34-32 loss to the Steelers.
items.s: Folk also had a missed PAT that was negated by a Steelers penalty, which resulted in the Jets trying a two-point conversion instead. New York didn't get it and spent the rest of the game chasing that point, ultimately failing another two-point conversion in the two-point loss. Folk was perfect on his official kicks, connecting on field-goal attempts of 35 and 51 yards. The Jets' offense was surprisingly effective in Week 1, giving the veteran kicker some additional upside ahead of a Week 2 home game against the Bills.

items.h: Folk went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made both of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 34-32 loss to the Steelers.
items.s: Folk opened Sunday's scoring with a 35-yard field goal in the first quarter before converting on a 51-yard try late in the second quarter to give the Jets a nine-point lead. Folk signed with the Jets in late July after spending the prior two seasons with the Titans, during which he was one of the most accurate kickers in the league. Next up for Folk and the Jets is an AFC East clash against the Bills on Sunday, Sept. 14.

items.h: Folk made his only field-goal attempt in Friday's 19-17 preseason loss to the Eagles.
items.s: Folk connected on a 41-yard field-goal attempt to end the first half. Meanwhile, Harrison Mevis missed a 55-yard attempt in the third quarter. Folk was already viewed as the favorite to win the Jets' kicking job after making 50 of 52 field-goal attempts over the previous two seasons with the Titans, and that standing was likely solidified Friday.

items.h: Folk made both of his field-goal attempts in Saturday's 31-12 preseason loss to the Giants.
items.s: Folk connected on his first two field-goal attempts of the preseason after Harrison Mevis went 3-for-3 in the preseason opener against the Packers. Most questions about the 40-year-old Folk's ability are tied to power rather than accuracy, so it's no surprise he had no trouble making field goals of 38 and 31 yards Saturday. Folk remains the favorite over Mevis in the Jets' kicking competition.

items.h: Folk signed with the Jets on Tuesday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
items.s: Folk, who kicked for the Jets from 2010-16, suited up for 14 regular-season games with the Titans in 2024 and remained effective, converting 21 of 22 field-goal attempts -- including all six of his kicks from 50-plus yards out -- and all 25 of his extra-point tries. Now entering his age-41 season, Folk will be the favorite to start for New York in Week 1 as long as he proves in training camp that his consistency hasn't slipped. His primary competition will be UFL standout Harrison Mevis after the team waived Caden Davis on Tuesday.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) is aiming to return for an 18th NFL season, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Folk missed the last three games of the 2024 regular season due to an abdominal injury, but he posted a video of himself kicking field goals Wednesday and appears to be fully healthy. Folk has led the league in field-goal percentage over the past two seasons, going 50-for-52 on field-goal attempts while making all six of his tries from 50-plus yards. Given his accuracy, the veteran should be on the radar of teams looking for an upgrade at kicker.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) made 21 of his 22 field-goal attempts and all 25 of his extra-point attempts across 14 games with the Titans in 2024.
items.s: Folk missed Tennessee's final three games, but he had a strong season otherwise. His only missed field goal came in Week 10 when he pushed a 49-yard attempt wide right, and he impressively made all six of his attempts from 50 yards away or further. Though he'll be entering his age-41 season, Folk should receive a contract this offseason -- whether in Tennessee or elsewhere -- after another strong campaign.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
items.s: Matthew Wright again should handle kicking duties for Tennessee in Week 18. Folk will close out the 2024 season missing his third straight contest, finishing 21 of 22 on field-goal attempts and registering an NFL-best 95.5 percent success rate. He also made all 25 of his extra-point tries. He's been nearly automatic in two seasons for Tennessee, leading the league in field-goal make percentage in both 2023 and 2024. The 40-year-old is scheduled to be a free agent in March.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
items.s: Folk has missed the Titans' last two games and was listed as a non-participant for each of the team's previous four practices before getting back on the field Thursday, albeit in a limited capacity. The Titans will reassess Folk following Friday's practice before determining whether he or practice-squad member Matthew Wright will handle the kicking duties in Sunday's season finale versus the Texans.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) didn't participate in Wednesday's walkthrough practice, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
items.s: Folk has missed the Titans' last two games due to an abdomen injury, and Wednesday's DNP likely suggests he's in jeopardy of missing a third in the Week 18 matchup against the Texans. The 40-year-old likely needs to upgrade to at least limited practice participation Thursday or Friday in order to suit up Sunday. It's unclear who would kick for Tennessee if Folk is sidelined in Week 18, as Matthew Wright was waived Monday after kicking for the team in Week 17.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Folk will miss a second consecutive game. The Titans plan to add Matthew Wright from their practice squad to fill in for Folk after Brayden Narveson missed his only field-goal attempt while kicking in Folk's place against the Colts in Week 16. Folk's last chance to suit up this season will come against the Texans in Week 18.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) didn't practice Thursday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
items.s: Folk's abdominal injury prevented him from playing in the Titans' 38-30 loss to the Colts in Week 16 and has now kept him sidelined for the team's first two Week 17 practices. According to Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com, the Titans remain hopeful that Folk will be able to handle kicking duties in this Sunday's game in Jacksonville, but Tennessee added some insurance by signing Matthew Wright to their practice squad Thursday. Wright would presumably be elevated to the roster Saturday if Folk is in any danger of missing a second straight game.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) was listed as a non-participant in Wednesday's practice estimate, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Folk missed the team's Week 16 loss versus the Colts with an abdomen injury and is now in danger of missing his second straight contest. If the 40-year-old ends up being unable to return for Sunday's game versus the Jaguars, Brayden Narveson will handle the kicking duties once again.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts.
items.s: Folk entered Sunday's game as a true game-time decision after managing only one limited practice session during the week. He's been a consistent kicker for the Titans this season, so his absence could affect the team's special-teams play. Brayden Narveson will take over the kicking duties.

items.h: Coach Brian Callahan said Friday that Folk (abdomen) will be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Colts, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: The Titans are expected to have Brayden Narveson elevated from the practice squad as insurance should Folk be unable to kick versus Indianapolis. Folk has been nearly automatic this season, making 21 of 22 field-goal attempts (95.5 percent) and all 25 of his extra-point tries. He's been the Titans' best means of scoring in 2024.

items.h: Folk (abdomen) was listed as a DNP on Thursday's injury report, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Folk has missed the Titans' first two practices of the week due to an abdominal injury, and it appears he is in jeopardy of being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Colts. The Titans have Brayden Narveson on the practice squad, and he would be elevated to the active roster should Folk not progress through his recovery enough to play. Folk has been one of the most accurate kickers in the NFL this year, going 21-for-22 on field-goal attempts and converting on all 25 extra-point tries through 14 regular-season games.

items.h: Folk didn't practice Wednesday due to an abdominal injury, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
items.s: Folk had been listed with a groin issue on Tennessee's Week 15 injury report, but he suited up in Sunday's 37-27 loss to the Bengals, converting on all three of his extra-point tries while not attempting a field goal. The Titans are now listing him with a different injury for Week 16, though it's possible the abdominal injury is linked to the groin issue. The Titans have another kicker on their practice squad (Brayden Narveson) that could be added to the active roster if Folk is unable to play this Sunday in Indianapolis.
